results.title: CirclePanel: End to end User Research Platform  | Product Hunt
results.content:
Why we're different 🌍

Every research tool was built in English, for English-speaking markets. Circle Panel is the first built natively for Arabic and English — with proper transcription, RTL support, and 20 Arabic analysis themes.

And unlike tools that just bolt AI onto the side, we ground AI in real user data — verified participants, real sessions, quality-checked responses. Not routine form-filling.

Pricing 💸

Starter $29/mo

Pro $49/mo

Business $119/mo

Coming soon 🚀 — prototype testing, surveys, and a participant panel of vetted experts.

We'd love your feedback — try it free at circlepanel.com and tell us what's missing. Every comment shapes what we build next. 🙏

Noah Elhadedy [...] Noah Elhadedy

This looks really useful, especially having the full research workflow in one place. Love that Arabic support is built in from day one. Congrats on the launch Mostafa 👏 [...] So I built Circle Panel the AI-native platform that runs your entire user research workflow in one place.

Here's what it does

AI Study Builder Describe your research goal in one sentence. Circle Panel generates your full study plan, discussion guide, and screener questions grounded in proven frameworks, not generic AI output.
